subject: Temporary evidence snapshot & short-lived S3 access for Vendr SIG delta
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ross <elena@vendr.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary evidence snapshot & short-lived S3 access for Vendr SIG delta

Hi Elena —

Following our security intake for the SIG/CAIQ delta, we need a short-lived export of the Vendr portal profile and associated artifacts so our compliance team can ingest answers and sample evidence for a scoped SIG review. Specifically we are requesting:

- A snapshot of the profile JSON/CAIQ answers for the following sections: Asset Inventory, Data Flows, Encryption, Access Controls.
- Supporting artifacts referenced in the profile (S3 object paths / zipped proof files, SOC2 evidence excerpts, configuration screenshots).
- If possible, a pre-signed S3 URL with a 48–72 hour TTL pointing to a single archive (preferred) OR a secure bundle delivered through your portal export.

We need this window to be as small as possible. Proposed timeline: 72-hour access starting Mon 2027-05-31 09:00 PT. If you can only do 48 hours we can adjust. We will not retain any evidence beyond 7 days and will delete any temporary copies immediately after ingestion — I’ve attached a short temp retention policy and an evidence manifest for the items we expect (evidence_manifest.csv).

Can you confirm scope and whether Vendr can provide a pre-signed S3 link versus a zipped bundle? Also let us know any PO/DPA or access request details you require from our side.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turn here.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: evidence_manifest.csv (CSV, 38KB); s3_temp_policy.txt (TXT, 2KB)

From: Elena Ross <elena@vendr.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: security-ops@vendr.com
Date: Fri, 29 May 2027 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Temporary evidence snapshot & short-lived S3 access for Vendr SIG delta

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the clear ask and the manifest — helpful. We can produce a snapshot but we have two guardrails to confirm before we can generate a pre-signed S3 export:

1) Scope confirmation: we need you to mark which CAIQ sections are high priority (we saw Asset Inventory + Encryption + Access Controls above; confirm if Data Flows is required).
2) Authorization: Vendr requires either (a) a PO referencing the request or (b) a signed Data Processing Addendum (if not already on file) for off-platform evidence exports. In past cases we've accepted an internal purchase order plus an emailed approval from the security contact.

Operationally we can do a 48-hour pre-signed S3 link and we will strip transient secrets from screenshots. We will bundle logs up to 90 days but will only include the minimum timestamps you request. We cannot provide DB-level dumps.

If you can confirm the scope and either attach the PO or point us to a signed DPA, we’ll schedule the snapshot for Monday morning.

Regards,
Elena Ross
Vendor Security Lead | Vendr
elena@vendr.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 29 May 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr snapshot request — internal plan and asks

Folks — quick internal note to summarize the ask from Vendr and next steps: 

- Vendr can produce a pre-signed S3 link but requires either a PO or signed DPA.
- Target window we requested: Mon 05/31 09:00 PT for a 48–72 hour TTL. If Vendr can only do 48h we’ll accept that (shorter is better).
- We will not retain copies beyond 7 days; security will orchestrate ingestion and permanent attachments will not be created without escalation.

Action items:
- Procurement (Ben): can you expedite a PO reference for this export? If procurement prefers, send a short email attestation instead of a formal PO — Vendr will accept either in many cases. HubSpot deal id: 8342 for context.
- Security (Irene): please confirm the temporary retention policy is acceptable (I attached the draft s3_temp_policy.txt to the original thread). If ok, I’ll forward the attestation to Vendr and ask them to proceed.
- Legal/Contracts (Monica): flag if you need a DocuSign for DPA or if we already have DPA coverage on file for Vendr.

If everyone can reply by EOD Friday we can lock Monday.

—Rishi

The export bundle: vendr_snapshot_20270531.zip (2.4GB) — trimmed screenshots and redacted transient secrets.

Pre-signed link: https://vendr-secure-downloads.s3.amazonaws.com/pre-signed/abc123-templink (expires in 48 hours)
